122124: A high school girl of self-professed low standing who has reincarnated as a spider. In her former life, she lived as a shut-in and immersed herself in video games, but now she uses her remarkable mental strength to fight for survival.
130478: Wrath, formerly known as Sasajima Kyouya, is one of the students that reincarnated. After reincarnation, he found himself reborn as a Goblin in a Goblin Village with the special skill to create weapons.
130479: The daughter of Duke Anabald. In her previous life, she was a boy named Ooshima Kanata, but she reincarnated as a beautiful girl. She's a prodigy on par with Shun, and has been his best friend since their former life.
130480: Potimas Harrifenas is the elf patriarch and ambassador of the Elf Village.
130481: In her previous life, she was Okazaki Kanami, homeroom teacher to the kids who were reincarnated, and they affectionately call her "Oka-chan." After reincarnating, she began attending school with Shun and the others as their classmate.
130482: Sophia Keren, formerly known as Negishi Shouko in her previous life, is one of the reincarnated students. She was reincarnated as a True Vampire in a noble human family, the Kerens. Her relatives are normal humans, so she hides the fact that she is a Vampire.
130483: Shun's pet Earth Wyrm. In her previous life, she was a girl named Shinohara Mirei, but she reincarnated as a monster instead of a human. As a monster, her stats grow at a very fast rate, and she has excellent situational judgment.
130486: The second princess of the Kingdom of Analeit. As Shun's half-sister, born to a different mother not long after his birth, her talents rival his.
130487: The fourth prince of the Kingdom of Analeit. His name in his previous life was Yamada Shunsuke. He was a textbook example of the average high school student and retains that quality after reincarnating.
130488: Güliedistodiez, also known as Gyurie, Kuro, or Black, is one of the Administrators of the System. He is described by Kumoko as "a very dark man."
130489: Ronandt is the chief of the imperial court wizards. He is the most prominent magic-user in the world and considered an amazing person who has even mastered Space Magic. He’s probably the strongest genuine human around. As Julius’s master, he was somewhat concerned about him.
130491: The crown prince of the Renxandt Empire. In his previous life, he was Natsume Kengo, and he was regarded as the leader of the class. His skills are the real deal, but his habit of exaggerating his own abilities detracts from the magnitude of his power.
130492: Merazophis is a human turned Vampire by Sophia. He is also her butler and was her caretaker when she was a toddler. At present, he is the Commander of the Fourth Demon Army, but continues to be Sophia's butler and one remaining family member from their hometown.
130494: A Saint candidate in the Holy Kingdom of Alleius. Her name in her previous life was Hasebe Yuika. She's very serious and well-mannered, but often loses sight of what's going on around her.
196477: The second prince of the Kingdom of Analeit. Julius is Shun's older brother and the strongest hero among all humankind. Despite his mastery of both swordsmanship and magic and his achievements in combat, he remains virtuous and not at all proud.
208069: Yaana is the previous Saint from the Word of God religion, dispatched to assist Julius in his responsibilities as the Hero.
208070: Hyrince Quarto is Julius's childhood friend as well as the tank of the Hero party. As the second son of Duke Quarto of the Analeit Kingdom, he is a proud noble who has dedicated himself to protecting his friends and home. He is an uncle-like figure in Shun's life.
210659: Asaka is an adventurer and Kunihiko's childhood friend, both before and after reincarnating.
211284: The Demon Lord's aide. Was formerly a leading member of the demon society, but since the Demon Lord's ascent he has sworn loyalty to her. His brother is Bloe, the commander of the Seventh Demon Army Corps.
212892: Shun's responsible older brother, the first prince of Analeit, the eldest son of the queen and thus first in line to the throne. His father, Meiges, thought that Analeit would be in good hands were Cylis to become king. Shun is unnerved by his seriousness
212893: Buirimus is a summoner and part a scouting unit from the Renxandt Imperial Army. Not only does he have great ability as a summoner, he is a skilled leader and a first-class warrior.
212894: The third prince of Analeit, born to a different concubine than Julius and Shun.
212895: Agner Ricep is one of the demon commanders. He is the leader of the Demon Lord's First Demon Army.
212896: Meiges Derra Analeit is the king of the Kingdom of Analeit.
212897: Kogou is the commander of Demon Lord Ariel's Third Demon Army.
212898: Bloe Phthalo is the brother of Balto and the Seventh Demon Army commander. He is a warrior who wields a greatsword; he is also a bit rough around the edges personality and looks-wise.
212899: Sanatoria is one of Ariel's commanders. She is the leader of the Second Demon Army.
212900: Darad is the commander of the 5th Demon Army Corps. He appears as a stern long-haired man wearing a jinbaori.
217318: Dustin LXI is the 57th pontiff of the Word of God Religion. An elderly man who stands at the very top of the world's largest religion. Followers venerate him as the person closest to God.
217328: Jeskan is a former adventurer that joined Julius' party.
217329: A former "gentleman thief" and a member of Julius' party.
217330: Kunihiko is an adventurer and Asaka's childhood best friend, both before and after reincarnating.
217696: Anna is a half-elf attendant who has served the royal family for successive generations of kings. She is like a foster parent of Schlain and Sue, and she serves as a maid and guard for them alongside her colleague Kleava.
226466: Goyef's father and a retired labyrinth guide.
226467: Basgath's son. He works as a guide in the Great Elroe Labyrinth. He has acted as a guide for Julius' party in the past. While he has considerable talented as a guide, he refused to be a guide for Shun's party who were on the wanted list.
227373: The lord of Keren County, a modest county in the north-east of Sariella. He is a kind governor, treating his people fairly. Husband to Seras and father to Sophia.
227374: The wife of John Keren and the Lady of Keren County. She's the mother of Sophia.
230373: Previously known as Kusama Shinobu he was reincarnated to a family that serves in the dark ops of Holy Kingdom of Alleius.
269411: She is the vice-commander of the Tenth Demon Army.
269412: The commander of the Sixth Demon Army. A youthful army general who specializes in magic.
269413: He is a member of the Tenth Demon Army.
